messages:
maria: Heads-up — per the postmortem (https://redwood.company/postmortems/INC-2026-022) Action Item #4 (KV cache eviction tuning) is past its due date. @sam was owner; can we get a short status and updated ETA? :wave:

sam: Sorry — ran into a blocker with the internal loader causing cache thrashing when seq len > 8k. I have a local fix and a test repro. PR WIP: https://git.redwood/infer/pr/4532. ETA for PR + review: EOD tomorrow. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: Marking this priority-high. If it's going to slip past tomorrow we need a rollback/fallback plan for Dedicated customers. @jen can you weigh in on escalation? :eyes:

jen: Thanks for the ping. Can you add the repro and perf numbers to the PR description, @sam? That'll speed reviews. If EOD slips, we'll schedule a 30m triage with infra and runtime to scope a temporary fallback.

sam: Will do — added `repro/kv-thrash.sh` and perf logs to the PR. Quick snippet in case reviewers want to run locally:
```bash
# repro: simulate many short prefixes + long tails
bash repro/kv-thrash.sh --clients 200 --seq 8192
```
I'll also attach a reduced trace in the PR. Updated ETA: tomorrow 6pm PT.

ops-bot: Reminder: Action Item #4 assigned to sam is overdue (due 1804234720). Please update status in the incident tracker: https://tracker.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-022/actions.

maria: Thanks — tagging the tracker too. @sam please confirm once merged so I can close the action in the PM and run the regression eval set.

sam: PR merged and canary on Dedicated region us-west-2 passed basic smoke. I ran the regression eval (prompt set `kv-regression-v2`) — no quality regression observed. Link to artifacts in PR.

jen: Confirming canary looked stable from infra side. No memory spikes in the last 12h.

alex: Awesome — @maria can you verify and mark closed? Also recommend adding a short note under recurring patterns about "KV eviction sensitivity to long sequences" so this shows up in future incident retros.

maria: Verified against the eval set and updated the postmortem: added remediation note and recurrence tag. Closing Action Item #4. :white_check_mark:

sam: Thanks — will follow up with a small follow-on task to parameterize the eviction threshold; not blocking this closure.

maria: Adding follow-on as a new low-priority action in the tracker assigned to sam. Closing thread. :v:
